[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | collector = y }} [[North Kryta Province]] is, as the name suggests, a large province in northern [[Kryta]]. It is also the location of the [[Ascalon Settlement]]. == Getting there == Head north from [[Lion's Arch]] or [[D'Alessio Seaboard (outpost)|D'Alessio Seaboard]]. == Shrines == ; Resurrection shrines: * Northwest corner, on the path to the [[Ascalon Settlement]], near the west entrance. * Northeast corner, on the path from the entrance from [[Scoundrel's Rise]]. * Southern half, approximately half-way between the entrances to [[Lion's Arch]] and [[D'Alessio Seaboard]], on the path running north. * South-southeast, just outside the entrance to Lion's Arch. * Southwest corner, just outside the entrance from D'Alessio Seaboard. == Quests available == * [[Archivist Ithimar]] ** [[Graven Images]] * [[Captain Greywind]] ** [[Blankets for the Settlers]] ** [[Reversing the Skales]] * [[Damaris]] ** [[The Ascalon Settlement]] * [[Farmer Dirk]] ** [[The Last Hog]] * [[Lionguard Riddik]] ** [[Duties of a Lionguard]] * [[Miraba]] ** [[Bandit Trouble]] == NPCs == These quests will affect the spawns in this area: * [[Defend North Kryta Province]] * [[Evil Residents]] * [[Evil Residents Code: Harmonica]] {{Quest icon|repeatable}} * [[Graven Images]] * [[Orrian Excavation]] * [[The Last Hog]] * [[Mhenlo's Request]] * [[Mustering a Response]] === Allies === [[Human]]s ([[Ascalon]]ians) * {{x}} 1 (20) [[Farmer Dirk]] * {{x}} 1 (24) [[Prize-Winning Hog]] * {{x}} 10 (20) [[Ascalonian Settler]]s * {{w}} 10 (20) [[Settlement Guard]]s Humans ([[Kryta]]ns) * {{x}} 20 (20) [[Lionguard Riddik]] * {{w}} 15 (20) [[Lionscout Gabrian]] Humans ([[Luxon]]s) * {{x}} 10 (20) [[Dalos Ekarus]] Humans ([[Kurzick]]s) * {{x}} 10 (20) [[Meika Ulrikar]] [[Golem]]s * {{d}} 20 (20) [[M.O.X.]] (before acquiring M.O.X. as a [[hero]]) Other * {{x}} 1 (20) [[Crevasse]] (during [[What Lies Beneath]];
